name: CommuteAssistUnfamiliarNeighborhood

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a short navigation scene where someone is walking or driving through an unfamiliar neighborhood and needs step-by-step help from Sigma. Allow 2-3 short exchanges as they navigate.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.tts_prompt: Clear and precise, step by step

sound_effects_config.prompt: City street sounds, outdoor urban walking, unfamiliar neighborhood, mixed traffic

initial_prompt: Generate a short navigation scene. The person is in an unfamiliar part of the city — on foot or just parked. They ask Sigma for directions to a specific place, get step-by-step help, and at some point ask a follow-up when they hit a confusing junction. Keep all exchanges very short.

user1.name: Jordan
user1.tts_prompt: A bit lost, looking around, slightly uncertain

variations.context: Navigating an unfamiliar neighborhood — asking Sigma for directions with a follow-up

setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo person in an unfamiliar area, using phone
setting.background: Visiting a new part of the city. Knows the destination name but not the streets. Needs Sigma to guide them.
setting.conversation_style: Short questions as they walk. Sigma gives incremental directions. One follow-up when something's confusing.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma how to get to their destination from where they are
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, how do I get to the market from here?' or 'Sigma, which way is Elm Street?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives first direction. Person starts walking.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one specific instruction — 'Turn left on Oak, walk 200 metres.' User: brief acknowledgement and starts moving.

scenario_template.topic: Person reaches a junction that doesn't match expectations — asks a follow-up
scenario_template.note: Short question. Under 70 chars. 'Sigma, there's no Oak Street here — where am I?' or 'Sigma, do I go left or straight at the roundabout?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma corrects or clarifies. Person finds their way.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one corrective instruction. Person: 'ah, got it' and moves.

user1.name: Jordan
user1.role: Person navigating on foot in an unfamiliar part of the city. Uses Sigma for step-by-step directions. Speaks in short questioning fragments.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant giving step-by-step walking directions. Each instruction is one clear sentence. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Person is walking and slightly disoriented — short questions.
Sigma gives one clear instruction per turn — no lists.
A real navigational confusion in the middle makes it authentic.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Each Sigma instruction is one sentence with a specific action.
No verbose directions. No 'please continue for approximately'.
